## Checklist

- [ ] Feature context file was created or updated under `docs/features/`.
- [ ] Feature context file is linked from `docs/features/README.md`.
- [ ] Unit tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Backend API changes include Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.
- [ ] Database table and column names use snake_case.
- [ ] Backend validation classes/schemas were added or updated where needed.
- [ ] Backend validation messages are meaningful.
- [ ] Frontend forms avoid HTML `required`.
- [ ] Frontend displays backend field errors beside matching inputs.
- [ ] Repositories and services are used where business logic or persistence is involved.
- [ ] Helpers/design patterns were used where they reduce complexity.
- [ ] Deep nesting and code smells were avoided.
- [ ] SOLID principles were followed.
- [ ] Lint/typecheck/test commands were run or skipped with a reason below.
- [ ] No unrelated refactors or formatting-only churn are included.
